Featured Article

Swift Package Manager: Modular Programming

A scalable iOS architecture that uses Swift Package Manager as the primary unit of application structure. Features, shared components, tests, and development tooling are encapsulated within independent packages to improve scalability, maintainability, and agent-assisted development.
